name: Smoke test new binary
command: tmpdir=$(mktemp -d); logfile="$tmpdir/server.log"; HTTP_ADDR=127.0.0.1:18407 USAGE_DATA_DIR="$tmpdir/data" ./bin/cpa-manager.exe >"$logfile" 2>&1 & pid=$!; trap 'kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true; rm -rf "$tmpdir"' EXIT; ok=0; for i in $(seq 1 30); do if curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:18407/management.html >"$tmpdir/panel.html"; then ok=1; break; fi; sleep 0.25; done; test "$ok" -eq 1 || { cat "$logfile"; exit 1; }; grep -q 'id="root"' "$tmpdir/panel.html"; printf 'embedded panel smoke test passed: bytes=%s\n' "$(wc -c < "$tmpdir/panel.html")"
description: Start the rebuilt binary and verify the latest embedded panel responds
